note: Thomas quotes Scripture constantly and almost never cites it (the English prints one reference, John 8:12), usually following the Latin Vulgate. 22 range-translators identified each quotation themselves and looked it up in the IRV Hindi (ebible mirror hin_irv, parsed locally; Take Root unreachable). Where the IRV says what the English quotes, its wording was spliced in by script.

A row is 'mined' only when the translator reported it verbatim AND the chapter body contains an exact byte substring of the IRV verse of 30+ characters (or the whole verse). Short IRV phrase splices (allusions under 30 characters), verses re-aimed to another person, Vulgate-sense renderings (e.g. Luke 17:21 'within you', Job 7:1 'life is a warfare') and deuterocanonical quotations (Sirach, Wisdom, Maccabees) are 'self_rendered'.

Inside verbatim quotations the IRV's यहोवा is sometimes kept and sometimes replaced by प्रभु (the English says 'the Lord'); replaced ones are self_rendered. AI-translated in-session; awaiting native review.
